```{r}
library(ape)
library(tidyverse)

# --- 1. Define lookup FIRST ---
# Fix the typo in lookup
lookup <- data.frame(
  ID = c("PV662072.1", "PV662073.1", "PV662076.1", "NC_011319.1",  # fixed underscore
         "AP009175.1", "OP057014.1", "OP035078.2", "NC_057981.1",
         "NC_011330.1", "NC_072284.1", "OP834098.1", "AP009176.1",
         "KU308378.1", "OP035246.1", "NC_030005.1"),
  Species = c("acant_poly", 
              "acant_quad_1",
              "acant_quad_2",
              "anop_lent",
              "kent_acul",
              "lactp_bica",
              "lactp_trig",
              "lacto_corn",
              "lacto_diap",
              "ostr_cubic_1",
              "ostr_cubic_2",
              "ostr_imma_1",
              "ostr_imma_2",
              "ostr_melea",
              "ostr_rhino"),  # also lowercased this
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# --- 2. Read data ---
morpho_data <- read.nexus.data("Ostracioidea_K95_WT83.nex")
dna_data <- read.dna(
  "muscle_results/muscle-I20260206-203642-0302-71998231-p1m.sqr.fa",
  format = "fasta"
)

# --- 3. Convert to matrices ---
dna_mat   <- as.character(dna_data)
morpho_mat <- do.call(rbind, morpho_data)

# --- 4. Add ID column to DNA df and merge with lookup ---
dna_df <- as.data.frame(dna_mat)
dna_df$ID <- rownames(dna_df)

dna_named <- merge(dna_df, lookup, by = "ID", all.x = TRUE)

# Check for any unmatched IDs (will have NA in Species)
unmatched <- dna_named[is.na(dna_named$Species), "ID"]
if (length(unmatched) > 0) message("Unmatched IDs: ", paste(unmatched, collapse = ", "))

# --- 5. Set Species as rownames to match morpho_mat ---
rownames(dna_named) <- dna_named$Species
dna_named$ID <- NULL
dna_named$Species <- NULL

# --- 6. Find shared taxa and combine ---
shared_taxa <- intersect(rownames(dna_named), rownames(morpho_mat))
message(length(shared_taxa), " shared taxa found")

combined_mat <- cbind(
  morpho_mat[shared_taxa, ],
  dna_named[shared_taxa, ]
)
```

```{r}
library(ape)

# Read the tree


# Lookup table
lookup <- data.frame(
  ID = c("PV662072.1", "PV662073.1", "NC_011319.1", "NC_009864.1",
         "OP057014.1", "OP035078.2", "NC_057981.1", "NC_011330.1",
         "NC_072284.1", "NC_009865.1", "OP035246.1", "NC_030005.1",
         "NC_009859.1"),
  Species = c("Acanthostracion polygonius", "Acanthostracion quadricornis",
              "Anoplocapros lenticularis", "Kentrocapros aculeatus",
              "Lactophrys bicaudalis", "Lactophrys trigonus",
              "Lactoria cornuta", "Lactoria diaphana",
              "Ostracion cubicus", "Ostracion immaculatus",
              "Ostracion meleagris", "Ostracion rhinorhynchos",
              "Triodon macropterus (outgroup)"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Replace tip labels with "Species (ID)" format
tree$tip.label <- sapply(tree$tip.label, function(id) {
  match_row <- lookup[lookup$ID == id, ]
  if (nrow(match_row) > 0) {
    paste0(match_row$Species, " (", id, ")")
  } else {
    id  # keep original if no match found
  }
})

# Plot
par(mar = c(1, 1, 2, 1))
plot(tree, 
     main = "Boxfish Mitogenome Phylogeny (GTR+G, 1000 bootstrap)",
     cex = 0.8,          # tip label size
     label.offset = 0.005)
nodelabels(tree$node.label, 
           cex = 0.6, 
           frame = "none", 
           adj = c(1.2, -0.3),
           col = "blue")
add.scale.bar()
```

# Plot

nodelabels(tree_rooted$node.label,

add.scale.bar()

```{r}
library(ape)
library(phangorn)

# ── 1. Read morpho matrix ──────────────────────────────────────────
morpho <- read.nexus.data("morpho/Ostracioidea_K95_WT83.nex")
morpho_mat <- do.call(rbind, morpho)

# ── 2. Convert to phyDat ──────────────────────────────────────────
morpho_phydat <- phyDat(morpho_mat, 
                         type = "USER", 
                         levels = c("0", "1", "2", "3"))

# ── 3. Build parsimony tree ────────────────────────────────────────
set.seed(42)
morpho_mp <- pratchet(morpho_phydat, 
                      trace = 0,
                      minit = 100,
                      k = 10)

# Check what we got
print(morpho_mp)
plot(morpho_mp, main = "Unrooted morpho parsimony tree")

plot(morpho_mp, 
     type = "unrooted", 
     main = "Unrooted Morpho Parsimony Tree",
     cex = 0.7,
     lab4ut = "axial") 
nodelabels(morpho_mp$node.label, cex=0.5, frame="none")
```

```{r}
# Root on Aracana as single outgroup taxon
morpho_mp_rooted <- root(morpho_mp, 
                          outgroup = "Aracana",
                          resolve.root = TRUE)

# ── Now do the side by side comparison ────────────────────────────
# Read and prepare the mito tree
tree_mito <- read.tree("/Users/Flo/Downloads/Boxfish/boxfish_mito_iqtree.treefile")

# Rename mito tips to morpho-style codes
mito_to_morpho <- data.frame(
  ID = c("PV662072.1", "PV662073.1", "NC_011319.1", "NC_009864.1",
         "OP057014.1", "OP035078.2", "NC_057981.1", "NC_011330.1",
         "NC_072284.1", "NC_009865.1", "OP035246.1", "NC_030005.1",
         "NC_009859.1"),
  morpho_code = c("acant_poly", "acant_quad", "Anoplocapros", "Kentrocapros",
                  "lactp_bica", "lactp_trig", "lacto_corn", "lacto_diap",
                  "ostr_cubic", "ostr_imma", "ostr_melea", "Ostr_rhino",
                  "Triodon"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

tree_mito$tip.label <- mito_to_morpho$morpho_code[
  match(tree_mito$tip.label, mito_to_morpho$ID)
]

# Keep only shared taxa between both trees
shared <- intersect(tree_mito$tip.label, names(morpho))
cat("Shared taxa:", length(shared), "\n")
cat(shared, sep="\n")

# Prune both trees to shared taxa only
tree_mito_pruned <- keep.tip(tree_mito, shared)
tree_morpho_pruned <- keep.tip(morpho_mp_rooted, shared)

# ── Side by side plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────
par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(1, 1, 3, 1))

plot(tree_morpho_pruned,
     main = "Morphological Parsimony\n(shared taxa only)",
     cex = 0.8,
     label.offset = 0.01)
nodelabels(tree_morpho_pruned$node.label,
           cex = 0.55,
           frame = "none",
           adj = c(1.2, -0.3),
           col = "blue")

plot(tree_mito_pruned,
     main = "Mitogenome ML\n(shared taxa only)",
     cex = 0.8,
     label.offset = 0.005)
nodelabels(tree_mito_pruned$node.label,
           cex = 0.55,
           frame = "none",
           adj = c(1.2, -0.3),
           col = "blue")
write.tree(tree_morpho_pruned, "morpho_topology.tre")
```

library(ape)

# Read the aligned fasta
aln <- read.dna("boxfish-seqs/mitogenomes/all_mitogenomes_aligned.fasta", 
                format = "fasta")

# Keep only the 11 shared taxa
shared_ids <- c("PV662072.1", "PV662073.1", "NC_011319.1", "NC_009864.1",
                "OP057014.1", "OP035078.2", "NC_057981.1", "NC_011330.1",
                "NC_072284.1", "OP035246.1", "NC_030005.1")

# Subset alignment - match by rowname prefix since headers have long descriptions
keep <- sapply(shared_ids, function(id) grep(id, rownames(aln)))
aln_pruned <- aln[keep, ]

# Check
nrow(aln_pruned)  # should be 11
rownames(aln_pruned)

# Write pruned alignment
write.dna(aln_pruned, 
          "boxfish-seqs/mitogenomes/all_mitogenomes_aligned_11taxa.fasta",
          format = "fasta")

```{r}
begin mrbayes;
    set autoclose=yes nowarn=yes;
    
    [Define partitions]
    charset molecular = 1-16476;
    charset morpho = 16477-16576;  [adjust to actual positions]
    partition myparts = 2: molecular, morpho;
    set partition = myparts;
    
    [Molecular model - GTR+G]
    lset applyto=(1) nst=6 rates=gamma ngammacat=4;
    
    [Morphological model - Mkv]
    lset applyto=(2) nst=1 rates=gamma ngammacat=4;
    prset applyto=(2) symdirihyperpr=fixed(infinity) 
                      coding=variable;
    
    [Unlink parameters between partitions]
    unlink statefreq=(all) revmat=(all) 
           shape=(all) pinvar=(all);
    
    [MCMC settings]
    outgroup NC_009859.1;
    mcmc ngen=5000000 nchains=4 
         samplefreq=1000 printfreq=1000
         savebrlens=yes filename=boxfish_total;
    sump burnin=1250;
    sumt burnin=1250;
end;
```

```{r}
# ── 1. Read data ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
morpho <- read.nexus.data("morpho/Ostracioidea_K95_WT83.nex")
mol <- read.dna("boxfish-seqs/mitogenomes/all_mitogenomes_aligned.fasta",
                format = "fasta")
rownames(mol) <- gsub(" .*", "", rownames(mol))

# ── 2. Build molecular matrix with missing data for morpho-only taxa
n_mol_chars <- ncol(mol)
n_morpho_chars <- length(morpho[[1]])
all_taxa <- name_map$morpho_code  # use morpho codes as universal names

# Create empty molecular matrix filled with ? for all 27 taxa
mol_combined <- matrix("?", 
                        nrow = nrow(name_map), 
                        ncol = n_mol_chars,
                        dimnames = list(all_taxa, NULL))

# Fill in molecular data for taxa that have it
for(i in 1:nrow(name_map)) {
  acc <- name_map$accession[i]
  if(!is.na(acc) && acc %in% rownames(mol)) {
    mol_combined[i, ] <- as.character(mol[acc, ])
  }
}

# ── 3. Build morpho matrix with missing data for molecular-only taxa
morpho_combined <- matrix("?",
                           nrow = nrow(name_map),
                           ncol = n_morpho_chars,
                           dimnames = list(all_taxa, NULL))

# Fill in morpho data for taxa that have it
for(i in 1:nrow(name_map)) {
  code <- name_map$morpho_code[i]
  if(code %in% names(morpho)) {
    morpho_combined[i, ] <- morpho[[code]]
  }
}

# ── 4. Combine into one matrix ─────────────────────────────────────
combined <- cbind(mol_combined, morpho_combined)
cat("Combined matrix dimensions:", nrow(combined), "taxa x", ncol(combined), "characters\n")
cat("Molecular partition: 1 -", n_mol_chars, "\n")
cat("Morpho partition:", n_mol_chars + 1, "-", n_mol_chars + n_morpho_chars, "\n")

# ── 5. Write nexus file ────────────────────────────────────────────
write.nexus.data(as.list(as.data.frame(t(combined))),
                 file = "boxfish-seqs/mitogenomes/total_evidence.nex",
                 format = "dna",
                 interleaved = FALSE)

# ── 6. Append MrBayes block ───────────────────────────────────────
mrbayes_block <- paste0('
begin mrbayes;
    set autoclose=yes nowarn=yes;

    [Define partitions]
    charset molecular = 1-', n_mol_chars, ';
    charset morpho = ', n_mol_chars + 1, '-', n_mol_chars + n_morpho_chars, ';
    partition totalevidence = 2: molecular, morpho;
    set partition = totalevidence;

    [Molecular model - GTR+G]
    lset applyto=(1) nst=6 rates=gamma ngammacat=4;

    [Morphological model - Mkv with gamma]
    lset applyto=(2) nst=1 rates=gamma ngammacat=4;
    prset applyto=(2) symdirihyperpr=fixed(infinity)
                      coding=variable;

    [Unlink parameters between partitions]
    unlink statefreq=(all) revmat=(all)
           shape=(all) pinvar=(all);
    prset applyto=(all) ratepr=variable;

    [Outgroup]
    outgroup Triodon;

    [MCMC]
    mcmc ngen=5000000 nchains=4
         samplefreq=1000 printfreq=1000
         savebrlens=yes filename=boxfish_total;
    sump burnin=1250;
    sumt burnin=1250;
end;
')

write(mrbayes_block,
      file = "boxfish-seqs/mitogenomes/total_evidence.nex",
      append = TRUE)

cat("Done! File written to boxfish-seqs/mitogenomes/total_evidence.nex\n")
file.exists("boxfish-seqs/mitogenomes/total_evidence.nex")
```

```{r}
list.files("~/Downloads/Boxfish/lastz_out/")
library(tidyverse)

# Function to parse MAF file and extract alignment blocks
parse_maf <- function(filepath) {
  lines <- readLines(filepath)
  s_lines <- lines[grepl("^s ", lines)]
  
  blocks <- lapply(s_lines, function(l) {
    parts <- strsplit(trimws(l), "\\s+")[[1]]
    list(
      src = parts[2],
      start = as.numeric(parts[3]),
      size = as.numeric(parts[4]),
      strand = parts[5],
      srcSize = as.numeric(parts[6])
    )
  })
  blocks
}

# Parse all MAF files
maf_dir <- "~/Downloads/Boxfish/lastz_out/"
maf_files <- list.files(maf_dir, pattern="\\.maf$", full.names=TRUE)

# Build data frame of alignment blocks
all_blocks <- map_dfr(maf_files, function(f) {
  species <- gsub("_vs_ref.maf", "", basename(f))
  species <- gsub("_mitogenome.*", "", species)
  species <- gsub("_", " ", species)
  
  blocks <- parse_maf(f)
  
  # Skip if fewer than 2 blocks (reference vs itself)
  if(length(blocks) < 2) return(NULL)
  
  ref_block <- blocks[[1]]
  query_block <- blocks[[2]]
  
  data.frame(
    species = species,
    ref_start = ref_block$start,
    ref_end = ref_block$start + ref_block$size,
    query_start = query_block$start,
    query_end = query_block$start + query_block$size,
    query_size = query_block$srcSize
  )
})
# Plot synteny
ggplot(all_blocks, aes(x=ref_start, xend=ref_end, 
                        y=species, yend=species)) +
  geom_segment(linewidth=8, aes(color=species)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=c(0, 16829), linetype="dashed", alpha=0.3) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels=scales::comma, 
                     name="Reference position (bp)",
                     limits=c(0, 17500)) +
  labs(title="Mitogenome synteny vs. Ostracion immaculatus reference",
       y="") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position="none",
        axis.text.y=element_text(face="italic", size=9))

coverage <- data.frame(
  Species = all_species,
  Mitogenome = all_species %in% mito_species,
  FToL_nuclear = all_species %in% ftol_species,
  Morphology = all_species %in% morpho_species
)

print(coverage)

# Summary
cat("\nTotal species:", nrow(coverage), "\n")
cat("Mitogenome only:", sum(coverage$Mitogenome & !coverage$FToL_nuclear & !coverage$Morphology), "\n")
cat("All three:", sum(coverage$Mitogenome & coverage$FToL_nuclear & coverage$Morphology), "\n")
cat("At least two:", sum(rowSums(coverage[,-1]) >= 2), "\n")
```

```{r}
# All locus search terms
locus_terms <- list(
  # Mitochondrial
  "COI"      = "COI[ALL] OR COX1[ALL] OR cytochrome oxidase subunit 1[ALL]",
  "cytb"     = "cytochrome b[ALL]",
  "16S"      = "16S[ALL] OR 16S ribosomal[ALL]",
  "12S"      = "12S[ALL] OR 12S ribosomal[ALL]",
  "ND2"      = "NADH dehydrogenase subunit 2[ALL] OR ND2[ALL]",
  "ND4"      = "NADH dehydrogenase subunit 4[ALL] OR ND4[ALL]",
  "ND1"      = "NADH dehydrogenase subunit 1[ALL] OR ND1[ALL]",
  "ND3"      = "NADH dehydrogenase subunit 3[ALL] OR ND3[ALL]",
  "ND4L"     = "NADH dehydrogenase subunit 4L[ALL] OR ND4L[ALL]",
  "ND5"      = "NADH dehydrogenase subunit 5[ALL] OR ND5[ALL]",
  "ND6"      = "NADH dehydrogenase subunit 6[ALL] OR ND6[ALL]",
  "COX2"     = "COX2[ALL] OR cytochrome oxidase subunit 2[ALL]",
  "COX3"     = "COX3[ALL] OR cytochrome oxidase subunit 3[ALL]",
  "ATP6"     = "ATP6[ALL] OR ATPase subunit 6[ALL]",
  "ATP8"     = "ATP8[ALL] OR ATPase subunit 8[ALL]",
  # Nuclear - FToL loci
  "4c4"      = "4c4[ALL]",
  "enc1"     = "enc1[ALL] OR ectodermal-neural cortex[ALL]",
  "ficd"     = "ficd[ALL]",
  "glyt"     = "glyt[ALL] OR glycine transporter[ALL]",
  "hoxc6a"   = "hoxc6a[ALL] OR hoxc6[ALL]",
  "kiaa1239" = "kiaa1239[ALL]",
  "myh6"     = "myh6[ALL] OR myosin heavy chain 6[ALL]",
  "panx2"    = "panx2[ALL] OR pannexin 2[ALL]",
  "plagl2"   = "plagl2[ALL]",
  "ptr"      = "ptr[ALL] OR parathyroid hormone receptor[ALL]",
  "rag1"     = "rag1[ALL] OR recombination activating gene 1[ALL]",
  "rag2"     = "rag2[ALL] OR recombination activating gene 2[ALL]",
  "rhodopsin" = "rhodopsin[ALL]",
  "ripk4"    = "ripk4[ALL]",
  "sh3px3"   = "sh3px3[ALL]",
  "sidkey"   = "sidkey[ALL]",
  "sreb2"    = "sreb2[ALL]",
  "svep1"    = "svep1[ALL]",
  "tbr1"     = "tbr1[ALL] OR T-box brain transcription factor[ALL]",
  "vcpip"    = "vcpip[ALL]",
  "zic1"     = "zic1[ALL] OR zinc finger protein ZIC1[ALL]"
)

# Run full grid
results_list <- list()
total <- length(target_species) * length(locus_terms)
counter <- 0

for(sp in target_species) {
  for(locus in names(locus_terms)) {
    counter <- counter + 1
    cat(sprintf("[%d/%d] %s - %s\n", counter, total, sp, locus))
    
    query <- paste0('"', sp, '"[ORGN] AND (', locus_terms[[locus]], 
                    ') AND 200:20000[SLEN]')
    
    res <- tryCatch(
      entrez_search(db="nucleotide", term=query, retmax=10),
      error=function(e) NULL
    )
    
    Sys.sleep(0.34)
    
    if(is.null(res) || res$count == 0) {
      results_list[[paste(sp, locus)]] <- data.frame(
        species=sp, locus=locus, accession=NA, length=NA, found=FALSE)
      next
    }
    
    summ <- tryCatch(
      entrez_summary(db="nucleotide", id=res$ids),
      error=function(e) NULL
    )
    
    if(is.null(summ)) {
      results_list[[paste(sp, locus)]] <- data.frame(
        species=sp, locus=locus, accession=NA, length=NA, found=FALSE)
      next
    }
    
    if(length(res$ids) == 1) {
      best_len <- summ$slen
      best_id <- res$ids[1]
    } else {
      lengths <- sapply(summ, function(x) x$slen)
      best_idx <- which.max(lengths)
      best_len <- lengths[best_idx]
      best_id <- res$ids[best_idx]
    }
    
    results_list[[paste(sp, locus)]] <- data.frame(
      species=sp, locus=locus,
      accession=best_id, length=best_len,
      found=TRUE)
  }
}

# Combine
coverage_ncbi <- do.call(rbind, results_list)

# Save results
write.csv(coverage_ncbi, "~/Downloads/Boxfish/ncbi_coverage.csv", row.names=FALSE)

# Visualize
coverage_wide <- coverage_ncbi %>%
  select(species, locus, found) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=locus, values_from=found, values_fill=FALSE)

# Heatmap
coverage_long <- coverage_ncbi %>%
  mutate(locus = factor(locus, levels=names(locus_terms)),
         species = factor(species, levels=rev(target_species)))

ggplot(coverage_long, aes(x=locus, y=species, fill=found)) +
  geom_tile(color="white", linewidth=0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("TRUE"="#2d6a4f", "FALSE"="#f0f0f0"),
                    labels=c("TRUE"="Present", "FALSE"="Absent")) +
  labs(title="NCBI data availability across taxa and loci",
       x="", y="", fill="") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1, size=7),
        axis.text.y=element_text(face="italic", size=8))
```

# What you already have
already_have <- coverage_ncbi %>%
  mutate(
    in_mitogenome = species %in% mito_species & locus %in% c("COI","cytb","16S","12S","ND2","ND4","ND1","ND3","ND4L","ND5","ND6","COX2","COX3","ATP6","ATP8"),
    in_ftol = species %in% gsub("_"," ", ftol_taxa) & locus %in% c("COI","cytb","16S","12S","ND2","ND4","4c4","enc1","ficd","glyt","hoxc6a","kiaa1239","myh6","panx2","plagl2","ptr","rag1","rag2","rhodopsin","ripk4","sh3px3","sidkey","sreb2","svep1","tbr1","vcpip","zic1"),
    source = case_when(
      in_mitogenome ~ "Mitogenome",
      in_ftol ~ "FToL",
      found ~ "NCBI only",
      TRUE ~ "Missing"
    )
  )

# Visualize with source
ggplot(already_have, aes(x=locus, y=species, fill=source)) +
  geom_tile(color="white", linewidth=0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c(
    "Mitogenome" = "#2d6a4f",
    "FToL" = "#52b788",
    "NCBI only" = "#f4a261",
    "Missing" = "#f0f0f0"
  )) +
  labs(title="Data coverage by source", x="", y="", fill="Source") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1, size=7),
        axis.text.y=element_text(face="italic", size=8))
